title: Hail to the King
lyrics:
[01:05.48]Watch your tongue or have it cut from your head
[01:09.52]Save your life by keeping whispers unsaid
[01:13.58]Children roam the streets now orphans of war
[01:17.58]Bodies hanging in the streets to adore
[01:21.73]Royal flames will carve the path in chaos
[01:25.89]Bringing daylight to the night (Night)
[01:29.91]Death is riding into town with armor
[01:33.66]They come to take all your rights
[01:36.49]Hail to the king
[01:40.58]Hail to the one
[01:44.47]Kneel to the crown
[01:48.49]Stand in the sun
[01:52.71]Hail to the king
[01:55.39](Hail, hail, hail)
[01:59.37]The king
[02:02.47]Blood is spilled while holding keys to the throne
[02:06.50]Born again but it's too late to atone
[02:10.61]No mercy from the edge of the blade
[02:14.51]Dare escape and learn the price to be paid
[02:18.63]Let the water flow with shades of red now
[02:22.80]Arrows black out all the light (Light)
[02:26.83]Death is riding into town with armor
[02:30.68]They come to grant you your rights
[02:33.55]Hail to the king
[02:37.41]Hail to the one
[02:41.52]Kneel to the crown
[02:45.51]Stand in the sun
[02:49.72]Hail to the king
[02:52.40](Hail, hail, hail)
[02:56.40]The king
[03:55.36]There's a taste of fear (Hail, hail, hail)
[03:59.40]When the henchmen call (Hail, hail, hail)
[04:03.44]Iron fist to tame them (Hail, hail, hail)
[04:07.57]Iron fist to claim it all
[04:13.09]Hail to the king
[04:17.03]Hail to the one
[04:21.18]Kneel to the crown
[04:25.16]Stand in the sun
[04:29.34]Hail to the king
[04:33.38]Hail to the one
[04:37.51]Kneel to the crown
[04:41.41]Stand in the sun
[04:45.64]Hail to the king (Hail, hail, hail)
